scoring_justification: Recompute expected bulk/surface energies and intensity ratio from analytic formulas using given physical parameters. Compare agent's reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: physical parameters to compute expected values
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper derived formulas, parameters chosen as plausible physical values
hidden_assets.generation_method: selected S=2, gmuB_HA=0.1 J, ck_abs=0.01, J=1, consistent with antiferromagnet examples
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The parameters are public inputs; the expected gold values are computed from the same formulas the agent must implement, so gold is derived analytically, not fabricated.

outputs.description: The JSON object must contain the three computed quantities: bulk spin-wave energy at zero wavevector (E_B(0)), surface spin-wave energy at zero wavevector (E_S^+(0)), and the ratio of integrated Stokes peak intensities for surface-to-bulk scattering in the absorptive case (I_S/I_B).

output_contract.notes: The material parameters (S, gμ_B H_A, and the optical absorption parameter) are provided in the instruction. The agent must compute the quantities using the paper's analytic formulas.
